items.statement: The calculation maps deposited CCDC 2453269 to complex 1/1m (Br) and CCDC 2453268 to complex 2/2m (Cl), then explicitly tracks parity-compatible neutral doublet and one-electron-reduced singlet states at the Cu atom.
items.expected: Both supplied records are matched by archive ID, formula and cell to the documented chemical system order (1=Br=2453269; 2=Cl=2453268); state charges 0/-1, executable multiplicities 2/1 and the Cu atom are traceably identified. The report distinguishes this parity repair from the source-reported 3/2 states.

items.statement: The submitted f_k+ values are supported by converged, consistently charge-partitioned neutral/reduced calculations.
items.expected: Convergence evidence and one consistent charge scheme are supplied for both systems, or a scientifically explicit bounded failure is reported.

items.statement: The Cu-centered local Fukui values are approximately 0.0182 for complex 1 (Br; CCDC 2453269) and 0.0299 for complex 2 (Cl; CCDC 2453268).
items.expected: Reported values support complex 1≈0.0182 and complex 2≈0.0299 within method/reporting variation; values are matched by complex identity, not ascending CCDC number.

items.statement: The larger Cu f_k+ for complex 2 supports stronger Cu-centered substrate interaction and the reported higher catecholase activity, without proving the entire catalytic mechanism.
items.expected: Interpretation states 2 has greater Cu electrophilicity/local Fukui response and connects it cautiously to activity.
